title: Rust: Distributed Lock
description: Implement a distributed lock algorithm with leader election and heartbeat.

steps.title: Lock Interface
steps.description: Define a `DistributedLock` trait with `acquire(&self, name: &str) -> bool` and `release(&self, name: &str) -> bool`. Create a simple `InMemoryLock` using a `HashMap<String, bool>`.
hints: `trait DistributedLock { fn acquire(&self, name: &str) -> bool; fn release(&self, name: &str) -> bool; }`

verification.failureMessage: Acquire and release a lock, print results.

steps.title: Lock with Timeout
steps.description: Add `try_acquire_with_timeout(name, timeout_ms)` that retries acquiring for a duration. Use `Instant` and loop. Print each retry attempt.
hints: Loop: if acquire succeeds return true. If deadline passed, return false.
Sleep a small interval between retries.

verification.failureMessage: Try to acquire with timeout and print the result.

steps.title: Leader Election
steps.description: Implement leader election: multiple nodes compete for a `"leader"` lock. The first to acquire becomes leader. The leader holds the lock with a heartbeat. If the leader disconnects, a new election occurs.
hints: Each node tries to acquire the leader lock.
The leader periodically renews the lock (heartbeat).
If the leader lock expires, other nodes can become the new leader.

verification.failureMessage: Run leader election and print the elected leader.

steps.title: Reentrant Lock
steps.description: Add reentrancy: a lock can be acquired multiple times by the same owner. Track `owner: String` and `count: u32`. Each acquire increments count, each release decrements.
hints: Track `(owner, count)` instead of just a boolean.
If same owner tries to acquire, increment count.
Release only frees when count reaches 0.

verification.failureMessage: Show that same owner can acquire the same lock multiple times.

steps.title: Lock with Fencing Token
steps.description: Add fencing tokens: each successful acquire returns a monotonically increasing token number. If a request comes with an old token, it's rejected. This prevents stale locks from causing issues.
hints: Requests include the token. Server checks it matches `current_token`.

verification.failureMessage: Acquire a lock and show the fencing token.
